_readme: Consulting offers shown on the home page. Keep 3 or 4; more dilutes the pitch. 'deliverables' should be concrete nouns a client receives, not activities.
intro: Ten years of C/C++ — from 16-bit tractor controllers to Fire TV middleware — plus the experience to lead the team around the code. Every engagement starts with a short call to check the fit.

items.title: Embedded & C++ development
items.summary: Firmware and application code for microcontrollers, FreeRTOS devices, and Qt interfaces — from the CAN bus to the screen the operator touches. Built the way I did it for seven years at John Deere: tested, simulated, and documented.
deliverables: Production C/C++ code with unit tests (Google Test)
Simulators for your hardware, buses, and protocols, so testing doesn't wait for the device
Architecture notes and a handover session with your engineers

items.title: Device porting & platform integration
items.summary: Moving an app, runtime, or SDK onto new hardware or a new OS. I've ported a major streaming app to Amazon's next-generation Fire TV, adapting Google's Cobalt runtime to a new non-Android operating system.
deliverables: Your software running on the target device
Middleware and API/ABI adapters for the new platform
Root-cause fixes and an integration report for what comes next

items.title: Product builds — web & AI
items.summary: Client apps from first sketch to production, like the coaching platform I build and run today: a React front end, a secure backend with role-based access, and AI features that earn their cost.
deliverables: A deployed React + TypeScript app with its own component library
Backend with auth, role-based permissions, and CI/CD
AI features — evaluation, assistants, search — with cost and latency in check

items.title: Technical & engineering leadership
items.summary: A part-time tech lead or engineering manager for your team. I've supervised 10+ engineers across 5 clients, run Scrum and PSI planning, and built the hiring and onboarding process for a growing team.
deliverables: Sprint cadence, rituals, and stakeholder reporting that stick
Hiring loops, interview guides, and an onboarding plan
Code review, architecture guidance, and career mentoring for your engineers
